title: 逻辑备份（iterdump）：结构与数据分离导出与重建
code:
import sqlite3

DDL = """
CREATE TABLE users(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, level INT);
CREATE TABLE orders(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, uid INT NOT NULL, amount INT NOT NULL);
"""


def fill(con):
    con.executemany("INSERT INTO users(id,name,level) VALUES (?,?,?)",
                    [(1, "alice", 3), (2, "bob", 1), (3, "carol", 2)])
    con.executemany("INSERT INTO orders(id,uid,amount) VALUES (?,?,?)",
                    [(101, 1, 500), (102, 1, 320), (103, 2, 80), (104, 3, 640)])
    con.commit()


def tables_of(con):
    return sorted(r[0] for r in con.execute(
        "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' ORDER BY name"))


def counts(con):
    return {t: con.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM %s" % t).fetchone()[0]
            for t in tables_of(con)}


def digest(con):
    import hashlib
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    for t in tables_of(con):
        h.update(("T:" + t).encode("utf-8"))
        for row in con.execute("SELECT * FROM %s ORDER BY id" % t):
            h.update(repr(tuple(row)).encode("utf-8"))
        h.update(b"|")
    return h.hexdigest()


print("=== iterdump 逻辑备份: 结构 + 数据分离 ===")
src = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
src.executescript(DDL)
fill(src)

dump = list(src.iterdump())
struct = [s for s in dump if s.upper().startswith(("CREATE", "PRAGMA"))]
data = [s for s in dump if s.upper().startswith(("INSERT", "REPLACE"))]
wrap = [s for s in dump if s.upper().startswith(("BEGIN", "COMMIT"))]
print("dump 语句总数 =", len(dump))
print("  结构语句(CREATE/PRAGMA) =", len(struct))
print("  数据语句(INSERT) =", len(data))
print("  事务包装(BEGIN/COMMIT) =", len(wrap))
print("结构语句内容 =")
for s in struct:
    print("  " + s)

full_sql = "\n".join(dump)
only_struct_sql = "\n".join(wrap[:1] + struct + wrap[-1:])

a = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
a.executescript(only_struct_sql)
print("[仅结构脚本重建] 表名集合一致 =", tables_of(a) == tables_of(src),
      " 行数 =", counts(a))

b = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
b.executescript(full_sql)
print("[全量脚本重建]   表名集合一致 =", tables_of(b) == tables_of(src),
      " 行数 =", counts(b))
print("[全量脚本重建]   内容校验和一致 =", digest(b) == digest(src))
